cities.name: Andorra la Vella
interests: Mountain Valley & Pyrenees Nature 🏞️ — Green valley floor surrounded by steep Pyrenees peaks.
Shopping & Urban Culture 🛍️ — Flagship stores, mountain gear and lively streets.
History & Old Town Walks 🏛️ — Stone houses, parliament building and quiet historic lanes.
cities.local_food_tip: Try traditional dishes such as 'escudella' (meat stew), 'trinxat' (potato–cabbage mash with bacon), game meat, cheeses and mountain-style specialties — warm, hearty and energizing. 🍲 For a proper Andorran 'borda' experience, look for places like Borda Estevet or Can Manel and order escudella, grilled meats and trinxat.
cities.full_day: Morning: 🌄 Start in the historic centre at Casa de la Vall, the former parliament house with stone walls, flags and views over the old town. → 🚶 Wander the narrow alleys of the Andorra la Vella Old Town (Barri Antic): stone houses, small squares and quiet corners. → ⛪ Step into Església de Sant Esteve, a Romanesque church with simple but atmospheric interior. → ☕ Late-morning coffee and pastry on a terrace near the old town or along Avinguda Meritxell, the main shopping avenue. Afternoon: 🌳 Head down to Parc Central, the city’s green lung: riverside paths, lawns, playgrounds and modern sculptures — perfect for a slow walk and photos. → 🛍️ Continue along Avinguda Meritxell and into the commercial area towards Escaldes for shopping (fashion, sports gear, electronics, souvenirs). → 🍽️ Lunch at a traditional restaurant like Borda Estevet or Can Manel: escudella, trinxat, grilled meats, mountain stews and local desserts. Late Afternoon: 🏞️ Walk or taxi up towards higher streets and small viewpoints above the centre, or return to Parc Central for a relaxed break by the river. → ☕ Stop for a hot chocolate or local beer in a café overlooking the park. Sunset: 🌇 Take the elevator and ramps up to Plaça del Poble, a rooftop square above the city with wide views over the valley — a great golden-hour photo spot with mountains all around. Night: 🌃 Evening stroll through the illuminated old town and shopping streets back towards Avinguda Meritxell. → 🍷 Dinner in a cozy borda-style restaurant (stone walls, wooden beams, fireplace) followed by a relaxed walk through Parc Central or a dessert stop in a pastry shop.

ideas: 🌼 Light hikes on the lower valley trails above Andorra la Vella as the snow melts and flowers appear.
☕ Warm drink stops in cafés around Casa de la Vall and the old town after a morning walk.
🚶 Urban strolls between Barri Antic and Parc Central — fresh mountain air without deep snow.
📸 Spring photography from Plaça del Poble, with still-snowy peaks above a greener valley.
🏞️ Combine morning shopping on Avinguda Meritxell with afternoon walks in nearby mountain trails above the city.
🌄 Evening views from Plaça del Poble as the valley slowly lights up.
🧀 Light mountain meals in places like Borda Estevet — cheese, cured meats and stews after hikes.
🌳 Picnics or lazy afternoons stretching out in the shade of trees in Parc Central.
🍂 Colorful valley slopes framed around the old town and Casa de la Vall — perfect for golden-hour shots.
🥘 Long lunches of escudella and trinxat in traditional restaurants such as Can Manel.
🏛️ Quiet visits to historical spots in the Old Town, with fewer visitors and calm streets.
🌧️ If weather turns rainy, duck into cafés near Parc Central and watch clouds move through the mountains.
❄️ Snow-dusted rooftops around Casa de la Vall and the historic quarter.
🔥 Bowl of hot escudella or mountain soup in a borda after a cold winter walk.
🏙️ Evening strolls through the lit-up streets by Avinguda Meritxell, with festive decorations in high season.
🌌 Clear winter nights from Plaça del Poble looking at stars above the valley.

public_transport_tips: 🚍 Interurban buses run across the valley and to other parishes — timetables and routes are on the official site bus.ad and Cooperativa Interurbana Andorrana.
🚶 The historic center, Old Town, Parc Central and Avinguda Meritxell are fully walkable — you rarely need a car once you’re in town.
📱 For live bus lines and stops around Andorra la Vella, use the Moovit Andorra public transit map. Download the Moovit app for Android or iOS for step-by-step directions.
🚗 If you rent a car to explore mountain roads, always check weather and snow conditions, especially in winter passes.

city_events.name: Andorra Mountain Markets
city_events.description: 🛍️ Local crafts, cheeses and mountain products set up around the city center, often near Parc Central and along Avinguda Meritxell.

city_events.name: Winter Welcome Fest
city_events.description: 🎄 Lights, guided walks and alpine dinners to mark the start of the winter season, with festive activities around Plaça del Poble and the historic centre.

cities.name: Escaldes-Engordany
interests: Spa & Wellness (Thermal Waters) ♨️ — Famous for hot springs and modern thermal complexes.
Urban Lifestyle & Shopping 🏙️ — Continuation of the main commercial avenues.
Nature & Valley Views 🌄 — Quick access to viewpoints and nearby valleys.
cities.local_food_tip: Besides escudella and trinxat, try local cheeses, cured meats and hearty mountain meals — perfect after a spa day. 🧀🍖 Around the spa area you’ll find restaurants like 13,5º or Ristorante Pizzeria Les Oques for fusion and Italian-style comfort food.
cities.full_day: Morning: ☀️ Start with a relaxing session at Caldea Thermal Spa in Parc de la Mola — hot thermal pools, indoor–outdoor lagoons and steam areas with mountain views. → 🧖‍♀️ Optionally upgrade to the Inúu (adult-only zone) inside the same complex for a quieter spa experience. Late Morning: 🌳 After spa time, take a gentle walk through Parc de la Mola, the small green area just in front of Caldea, then continue along Avinguda Carlemany, the main shopping street that links into Andorra la Vella’s commercial zone. Afternoon: 🖼️ Visit the Museu Carmen Thyssen Andorra, a compact but high-quality art museum with rotating exhibitions in a modern setting. → 🍽️ Lunch nearby, choosing between creative cuisine at 13,5º or pizza and pasta at Les Oques. → 🛍️ Spend some time in and around Illa Carlemany Shopping Centre for clothes, cafés and a quick snack. Late Afternoon: 🌄 Take a taxi or bus up towards Engolasters Lake, a reservoir above Escaldes with pine forests, walking loops and viewpoints back over the valley. Nice place for calm walks and photos in late light. Sunset: 🌇 Watch the sun drop behind the surrounding peaks either from the shores of Engolasters Lake or from balconies back in the town around Caldea, where the glass tower glows as lights turn on. Night: 🌃 Enjoy dinner in Escaldes-Engordany — either something light after spa time or a full mountain meal. → Afterward, walk along Avinguda Carlemany and back toward Parc de la Mola or the illuminated spa building for nighttime photos.

ideas: ♨️ Thermal waters at Caldea are especially enjoyable in fresh spring air — warm pools while mountains still hold snow.
🌸 Easy walks around Parc de la Mola and along Avinguda Carlemany as terraces fill up again.
☕ Light lunches and coffee on outdoor terraces near Illa Carlemany after a spa session.
📸 Spring sunlight reflecting on the glass facades of Caldea with snow-capped peaks behind.
🏕️ Day trips from Escaldes to higher hiking routes and viewpoints, with easy access to Engolasters Lake and surrounding trails.
🍨 Ice cream and light meals on Avinguda Carlemany in the evening when temperatures drop.
🌙 Night walks under cooler alpine air between Caldea and central plazas.
🧖‍♀️ Late-evening spa visits — soaking outside at Caldea while stars come out.
🌾 Golden foliage on the drive up to Engolasters Lake — easy nature walks with crisp air.
🥘 Mountain dishes in restaurants near Illa Carlemany, mixing shopping and gastronomy.
📸 Evening shots of the lit spa tower of Caldea against darkening autumn skies.
♨️ Combine chilly afternoon walks in the valley with warm wellness time at the spa — the ultimate autumn reset.
♨️ Hot outdoor pools at Caldea while snow falls around the valley — one of Andorra’s signature experiences.
🔥 Comfort food dinners (escudella, grilled meats and cheeses) in cozy restaurants near the spa.
❄️ Short winter strolls along the streets linking Escaldes and Andorra la Vella, with Christmas lights and decorated shop windows.
🌌 Night views of the illuminated spa complex reflected on nearby buildings and the river.

public_transport_tips: 🚍 Escaldes-Engordany is linked to Andorra la Vella and other parishes by frequent buses — check lines and times on bus.ad.
🚶 Most of the town is walkable: Caldea, Avinguda Carlemany, Illa Carlemany and many hotels are within a short stroll.
📱 For public bus routes across Andorra (including Escaldes), use the Moovit app with Andorra selected — download it from Google Play or App Store.
🚗 Taxis or rental cars are handy for reaching higher viewpoints like Engolasters Lake, especially outside high season when bus frequencies are lower.

city_events.name: Wellness & Mountain Fair
city_events.description: 🛁 Spa-focused weekends with special packages at Caldea, plus local markets and outdoor walks around Parc de la Mola.

city_events.name: Autumn Food & Craft Days
city_events.description: 🧀 Tasting local cheeses, charcuterie and mountain dishes in restaurants near Avinguda Carlemany, with stalls selling crafts and valley souvenirs.

cities.name: La Massana / Canillo (Mountain Areas)
interests: Hiking & Mountain Nature 🥾 — Trails, lakes and high ridgelines with Pyrenees views.
Ski & Winter Sports ⛷️ — Access to Vallnord Pal-Arinsal and Grandvalira sectors.
Rustic Village Charm & Rural Life 🏡 — Traditional borda houses, stone churches and quiet valleys.
cities.local_food_tip: Mountain cuisine here means grilled meats, game, wild mushrooms, hearty stews, cheeses and potato/cabbage dishes — perfect after skiing or hiking. 🌲🍽️ Look for classic borda restaurants like La Borda de l’Avi, Borda Xixerella in La Massana, or La Cantina dels Racons near Canillo.
cities.full_day: Morning (La Massana focus): 🏔️ Take the gondola from La Massana Cable Car Station up to the Vallnord Pal-Arinsal ski and mountain area. In winter: ski, snowboard or try beginners’ slopes with ski schools. In summer: hiking trails, bike park routes and high-altitude viewpoints. → 🥾 Short walk or chairlift to viewpoints looking down onto the valley. Lunch: 🍲 Eat at a mountain restaurant on the slopes (for example one of the lodges in the Pal sector) or head back down to La Massana for a traditional meal at La Borda de l’Avi or Borda Xixerella — think escudella, trinxat, grilled meat and homemade desserts. Afternoon (Canillo focus): 🚐 Drive or take a bus towards Canillo village. → ⛪ Visit Església de Sant Joan de Caselles, a postcard-perfect Romanesque church just outside Canillo, surrounded by mountains. → 🚡 Ride the gondola from Canillo Cable Car up into the Grandvalira ski area (winter for skiing; summer often for walks and activities). Late Afternoon: 🌄 Head up by road or taxi to the spectacular Mirador Roc del Quer, a dramatic viewpoint platform jutting out over the valley with glass sections and huge panoramas — one of Andorra’s best photo spots. Sunset: 🌇 Watch the sky change colors from Roc del Quer viewpoint or from one of the high mountain points in Vallnord Pal-Arinsal, with valleys glowing below. Night: 🔥 Return to La Massana or Canillo for dinner by the fireplace in a borda — for example at La Cantina dels Racons or La Borda de l’Avi. → Enjoy a calm mountain evening under a starry sky with almost no city light.

ideas: 🌿 As snow melts, low and mid-altitude trails around La Massana and Canillo reopen — perfect for quiet nature days.
🌼 Wildflowers and green slopes near Pal-Arinsal and the routes around Sant Joan de Caselles.
🏕️ Simple picnic evenings in the valley or in rustic lodges after half-day hikes.
📸 Clear views from Roc del Quer with snow still on the highest peaks.
🥾 Long hikes across the ridgelines and lakes in the Vallnord Pal-Arinsal area or around the upper valleys above Canillo.
🚵 Mountain biking in the Vallnord bike park (La Massana gondola) followed by a big meal in La Borda de l’Avi.
🍃 Escaping heat from lower countries by staying several days in villages like Arinsal or Canillo.
🌌 Stargazing from high viewpoints or mountain hotels, far away from city light pollution.
🍁 Red and gold forests on the slopes above La Massana and around Sant Joan de Caselles — amazing photo spots.
🥘 Hearty food and local wine by the fireplace in borda restaurants such as Borda Xixerella or La Cantina dels Racons.
🛖 Quiet stays in alpine cabins or small hotels, ideal for reading, board games and slow travel.
📷 Misty mornings and crisp afternoons from Roc del Quer viewpoint.
⛷️ Skiing and snowboarding at Vallnord Pal-Arinsal (from La Massana or Arinsal) and Grandvalira Canillo sector.
🔥 Après-ski dinners with escudella, trinxat and grilled meats in traditional borda houses.
❄️ Snowshoe or easy winter walks around the upper stations with views down onto snowy valleys.
🌙 Quiet snowy nights in Arinsal, La Massana or Canillo — perfect for stargazing after a hot drink.

public_transport_tips: 🚍 Regular regional buses from Andorra la Vella connect to La Massana, Arinsal and Canillo — check line maps and timetables on bus.ad.
🚡 In winter and summer, access Vallnord Pal-Arinsal directly from the La Massana gondola, and Grandvalira via the Canillo gondola.
📱 Use Moovit’s Andorra bus maps and app (available on Android and iOS) to see which bus reaches your village or cable car station.
🚗 If you’re driving to high mountain car parks, always check forecasts and road conditions — snow chains or winter tires may be required in heavy snow.

city_events.name: Mountain Hiking & Nature Week
city_events.description: 🥾 Guided hikes and nature activities in the Vallnord Pal-Arinsal area and around villages like Arinsal and Canillo.

city_events.name: Winter Sports Opening Festival
city_events.description: 🎿 Start of ski season celebrated with music, torch-lit descents and special dinners in mountain restaurants across Pal-Arinsal and Grandvalira Canillo sector.
